section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study conducted in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The initial sample was 660 women, which was reduced to 591 women after excluding non-Malay and non-Chinese participants. The final analyzed sample consisted of 315 Malay women and 276 Chinese women, with mean age and BMI provided for each subgroup.
